newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium's Telinfo seeks capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's Telinfo seeks capital increase.

text.p: Belgian telecommunications and information group Telinfo is seeking a capital injection of two billion francs to fund expansion in Europe, De Financieel Economische Tijd reported on Saturday.

The paper also quoted Telinfo chairman John Cordier as saying Mobistar -- the GSM telephone operator in which it has a ten percent stake -- was likely to pay its first dividend in three years, a year earlier than expected.
The two billion franc capital injection is twice that which the company earlier this year said it would seek in the second half of 1997.
Cordier told the Tijd that Telfino would use the capital to fund expansion in France and Spain.
Telfino is 40.6 percent-owned by Belgian steel maker Sidmar, a unit of Luxembourg's Arbed Group and 28.4 percent- owned by the Cordier Group.

Telfino was recently upgraded to "accumulate" by Belgian brokerage firm KB Securities on the grounds that telecoms deregulation in Europe and internet capacity would benefit the company. -- Brussels Newsroom ++ 32 2 287 6832
